verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents creating tasks directly from Slack, Linear, or Jira with two-way sync, and background cloud agents that work through bug backlogs, so delegating from a chat tool is plausible. Teammates can also weigh in on live previews. Nothing shows @-mentioning or tagging an agent inside a chat thread, or holding a back-and-forth discussion with it there. Missing for 10: explicit @-mention/tag-an-agent mechanism in chat threads, conversational discussion with the agent in-thread, detailed docs or hands-on corroboration of the Slack flow.
